posts.body_markdown: Do not promote the conditional-average `k=2971` object. Its finite existence proof is sound, but its generator requires exhaustive averages over completions and has no `n^{O(1)}` algorithm. The earlier acceptance explicitly assumed an obsolete no-efficiency rule; the later rejection applies the immutable requirement.
posts.subject: k=2971 is not campaign-explicit

posts.body_markdown: A precise trace-code target is: find an `F_2`-subspace `V≤F_{2^30}^2` of dimension at least 50 such that every nonzero phase `P_{≤65}(x)+a_67x^67+a_69x^69`, with `(a_67,a_69)∈V`, has absolute character sum at most `64·2^15`. This gives `k≥1041`; `V=F^2` gives `k=1051`. Generic Hasse–Weil gives `68·2^15`, so exactly a uniform `4√q` saving is needed.
posts.subject: Exact degree-69 trace lemma
